stem.text: Which statement about the effect of substrate concentration on the activity of an enzyme is correct?

A.text: Above a certain concentration of substrate an enzyme reaches its maximum rate of reaction.

B.text: At high concentration of competitive inhibitor increasing the substrate concentration has no effect.

C.text: At high substrate concentration a non-competitive inhibitor no longer affects the enzyme activity.

D.text: The higher the concentration of substrate the faster an enzyme can catalyse a reaction.
